title: Observability: ioctl_init failure paths emit no pr_err
description: ioctl_init (src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:604-624) can fail with -ENOENT for at least 4 distinct reasons: (1) no provider found for the requested algo, (2) REQUIRE_FIPS set but no FIPS provider loaded, (3) fips_gate() returned non-zero, (4) sess_init failed. None of these failure paths emit a pr_err or pr_debug with the algorithm name, provider name, or originating error. A user sees 'INIT ioctl failed: -ENOENT' with no corresponding kernel log entry. All four paths need distinct pr_err messages.
close_reason: Added pr_debug for no-provider case, pr_info_ratelimited for REQUIRE_FIPS rejection; fips_gate failure already logged by wolfssl_fips_gate
